upAutoHint: This browser asks GitHub once a day whether a new version exists. The Cardputer only contacts the official release site (indecenti.github.io): to check versions and to download the updates you start.
upDevBuild: Development build newer than the latest release.
upCheckFail: Check failed (offline or GitHub rate limit). Try again later.
upPagesLag: Release just published: the download site is not aligned yet. Try again in a few minutes.
upNoOtaAsset: This release has no browser-OTA image: use the web flasher.
upFlashing: Writing firmware to the device… do not power it off.
upFailTimeout: The device did not come back online: check it manually (web flasher if needed).
upBusy: Device busy (another download is running). Try again shortly.
upHosted: Installed by M5Launcher: update NucleoOS from the Launcher (OTA).
upAuthFail: Session not paired: reopen the shell and pair again.
upFlashHint: Downloads the OTA image from the official site, verifies its integrity (SHA-256) and streams it to the device. The Cardputer reboots on its own; if the new image fails to boot it rolls back to the previous version automatically.
rebootLater: The Cardputer has just been updated and is confirming the new firmware: restart it in a few seconds.
upOtherLayout: Unrecognised memory layout: update NucleoOS over USB (web flasher).
upPrevPending: The Cardputer is still confirming the previous update: waiting a few seconds…
upConfirming: The new firmware has started: checking it stays stable before it is confirmed (about 20 s)…
upRolledBack: The new firmware did not stay stable: the Cardputer went back to the previous version on its own. No data was touched.
sdcHint: The web OS, the apps and ANIMA's knowledge live on the SD card. The update downloads only the changed files from the official site and verifies each one (SHA-256); your data, keys and settings are never touched.
sdcManual: Copied by hand from release {tag}: not verified yet.
sdcOutdated: Needs an update: the card is at {card}, the firmware at {fw}. Only the changed files are downloaded.
sdcPartial: An install was interrupted: it resumes where it stopped.
sdcMissing: The web OS is not on the card.
sdcUnknown: Unrecognised version (copied by hand, or a development build).
sdcNeedNet: It needs a Wi-Fi network with internet access (the Cardputer is in hotspot mode now).
sdcAfterFlash: Firmware updated: now bring the card to the same version.
sdcConfirmHint: The Cardputer restarts, downloads the changed files and comes back on its own: a few minutes for an update, up to half an hour for a first install. Keep it on and powered. Press again to confirm.
sdcArmFail: The Cardputer did not accept the request. Try again shortly.
sdcOldFw: This firmware cannot update the card from the browser: update the firmware first.
sdcTimeout: No news from the Cardputer for 45 minutes: check its screen.
sdcRebooting: The Cardputer is restarting to download the content…
sdcDownloading: Downloading on the Cardputer ({time}): keep it on and powered. Its screen shows the progress.
sdcFailed: The update failed: {why}. Try again later.
sdcNotFinished: The update did not finish: try again later.
langHint: Set the system language for ANIMA, the copilot and voice. Applies instantly across the OS.
langStatusOk: Interface translated — {n} surfaces, {k} strings, {langs} in sync.
dispHint: Turning it off drives the backlight to 0 (black) without changing the set brightness. It is the only live lever for the screen over the web; it does not query the panel on open, to avoid waking it.
briVolHint: Brightness and volume are saved in settings and applied at the next boot (the firmware exposes no hot setter for these).
wpLoadHint: Open this tab to load wallpapers…
wifiScanHint: The scan is on demand and read-only. To connect or change network use the native Wi-Fi app: the firmware exposes no join endpoint over the web.
changesNextBoot: Changes are saved and applied at next boot.
ipv6Hint: IPv6 is disabled in the firmware to free SRAM: all networking runs over IPv4. lwIP’s IPv6 tables are allocated at compile time — this control only records the preference; to truly re-enable it, rebuild with CONFIG_LWIP_IPV6=y.
aiProfileHint: Choose how ANIMA should reason. The system detects what is actually available — online keys, browser GPU, offline brain — and enables only the feasible profiles, explaining what is missing.
whatCurrentCanDo: What the current setup can do
advSettings: Advanced settings · provider, key, offline brain, voice
brainsChainHint: ANIMA has five minds and tries them in order, from the most capable to the always-available one. It leans on browser/PC power first and scales down to the Cardputer only as the final safety net.
brain1Desc: Claude / Groq / Grok — needs a key + Internet. The most capable.
brain2Desc: A full LLM on the browser GPU (WebLLM). Offline after the first download.
brain3Desc: The Cardputer cascade compiled to WebAssembly, on the browser CPU. Last step before the Cardputer.
brain4Desc: The brain in the device. Always available and offline: the final safety net.
brainPcDesc: Ollama / LM Studio on this computer: free, offline, private. Before or after the cloud, as you choose in “Models on your PC”; it stays on in Private mode too.
pcModelsHint: An AI server on this computer — Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or Jan — answers ANIMA, the copilot and Agents with no key and no Internet. Applies to this browser.
pcNone: No AI server is running on this computer. Install Ollama (ollama.com) or LM Studio, start it and press Detect.
pcOffHint: Off: ANIMA, the copilot and Agents do not use the PC models.
pcStBlocked: ⛔ the browser blocks access to this computer
pcBlockedHint: The browser stops this page from reaching programs on the computer. In the site settings (the icon left of the address) allow “local network access”, then press Detect.
pcAutoHint: Automatic picks, for each task, the best model that fits the GPU, from what was measured on this computer.
pcOrderHint: Only matters when you also have a cloud key; in Private mode the cloud is never used.
pcAddBad: Not a valid address: write e.g. http://192.168.1.20:11434
pcAddDup: This server is already in the list.
l1PolicyHint: In Auto the offline brain stands aside (freeing ~31 KB) when a stronger brain is available (online or browser LLM). Always keeps it resident, Never never serves it.
aiKeysHint: 🎨 Generating images with AI in Paint (Atelier) requires a Grok (xAI) key — model grok-2-image. Claude and Groq do not draw, but they can improve the prompt. 🎙️ Voice transcription (Recorder, Dictation) always uses Groq/OpenAI (Whisper), even with Claude, Gemini or Grok as chat.
edgeWebHint: In Browser mode, when the local brains do not know, it fetches the certain answer from Wikipedia (from the browser, never from the Cardputer) and caches it: from then on it stays offline. Off = only already-cached knowledge (nothing leaves the device).
edgeBrainHint: The same Cardputer engine compiled to WebAssembly: it opens apps, computes, answers and learns without anything leaving the device. It downloads once (~14 MB), then works even with the Cardputer off. With on-demand web search it becomes a hub of certain knowledge that grows with use.
voiceAlwaysHint: Keeps voice commands (PTT with the FN key) always ready from the home screen. Costs ~16 KB: leave it off until you have recorded the commands.
deviceNameHint: The name is used by mDNS/Swarm and applies at the next boot.
maintenanceHint: A reboot reloads the firmware and ANIMA index from SD. For firmware updates use the Updates tab: it downloads, verifies and installs the latest release in one click.
sessionsHint: Every browser paired with the PIN is a session. If a device was lost or you used an untrusted network, revoke sessions. Unused ones expire on their own after 90 days.
revokeAllDone: All sessions revoked — re-pair with the PIN
revokeAllConfirm: Tap again to revoke ALL sessions (you will need to re-pair with the PIN)
heapOpenHint: Open this tab to read the heap…
logsHint: RAM ring ~2 KB · works even without SD/serial.
privacyHint: Only /api/status (discovery) stays public on the local network and shows SSID/IP. Logs and diagnostics (/api/logs, /api/diag, /api/heap, /api/cpu) now require pairing. On untrusted networks use the device’s WPA2 hotspot.
aboutHint: App version 1.0 · Control Center with live Pulse, scenes, command bar and self-test. Built to give full control from the web without ever overloading the Cardputer.
rebootBody: Do you really want to reboot the device? Active connections will drop.
teacherReadFailed: Couldn't read the AI configuration (teacher.json) from the Cardputer: the key is not added so the existing keys aren't erased. Try again shortly.
teacherReadCorrupt: The AI configuration file (teacher.json) on the Cardputer can't be read: it is left untouched so no key is lost. Fix it or re-enter the main key first.
settingsReadFailed: Couldn't read the settings from the Cardputer: nothing is saved so they aren't overwritten. Try again shortly.
settingsReadCorrupt: The settings file on the Cardputer can't be read: it is left untouched.
settingsNotPaired: This browser isn't paired with the Cardputer — pair it to save settings.
rebootDoneMsg: Device rebooting — reload the page in a few seconds
kbEmpty: no entries yet (grows with online use)
apL1Auto: offline brain stands aside when a stronger one is active
apSavedRetry: Profile saved — some live steps need a retry
apPastePost: key (kept on device, used only for that feature):
